use_cases: Displaying a single tweet in social media applications and feeds
Showing user-generated social proof on landing pages
Creating Twitter/X integration components for web apps
Adding testimonial-style content with real social media appearance
ai_summary: A glass-morphism styled Tweet Card component for displaying social media content. Features translucent backgrounds with backdrop blur effects, gradient borders, and responsive design. Supports displaying author information, tweet content with multiple lines, verification badges, timestamps, and embedded reply threads. Ideal for integrating social media content into SaaS applications, landing pages, or social proof sections.
